name: Junkuma
source:
Age: not set
Likes: little kids, cute girls, capital punishment
Skill: massacring
Role: NPC who is a friend to good children

A cartoon mascot character that appeared in Judgement 7's fifth game "Rakuen Pororokka". The original deisgn was "a cute, gentle and somewhat foolish bear" by [url=/c62609]Tatiana[/url], but [url=/c62608]Natsumi[/url] added her own touch to it by equipping its entire body with machine guns, rocket fists, railguns and the like, turning it into a cartoony ultimate killing machine.

[Translated from [url=http://oreowa.jp/character/junkuma.html]the official site[/url]]
